question: How does a growing robot push its way through sand?
answer: The robot blows a jet of air out of its front. That loosens the sand, so the sand pushes back much less. Then the robot just extends its tip and makes its way through.
move: Loosen the sand with air, and plain tip growth gets through.

web.label: Card titled Soft Robots asks how a growing robot pushes through sand, showing two cases: growing with no air, and growing with an air jet at the tip. The reveal says the air loosens the sand so the tip can extend through.

source: Veritasium, “This Unstoppable Robot Could Save Your Life” (YouTube, 2021)
